items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: I'll ask Eddie Richardson Hill, I guess.

ctx.x: Where does Dave live now? I don't know where Dave's live. Somehow it's fun. But Dave really good trap drum, too. Dave is old, I'm telling you. Dave Bailey got a good age. Well, I'll have to dig up his address.
I'll ask Eddie Richardson Hill, I guess. Dave Bailey. You might have it out of you, bro. Yeah.
You're looking at it. Because I know he's an old-timer. Dave was an old-timer.
